Message:
drm/panel: simple: Add support for KEO TX31D200VM0BAA

This adds support for the Kaohsiung Opto-Electronics.,
TX31D200VM0BAA 12.3" HSXGA LVDS panel, which can be
supported by the simple panel driver.
